string.name: shareProfile
string.comment: Menu action that shares a user profile.

string.name: sharePuzzle
string.comment: This is shown in the puzzle screen. When pressed, the user can share the puzzle.

string.name: shareTournament
string.comment: Menu action that shares a tournament.

string.name: showComments
string.comment: Shown in the analysis screen.

string.name: showEngineLines
string.comment: Analysis/broadcast/study settings switch that toggles engine lines.

string.name: showEvaluationGauge
string.comment: Analysis/broadcast settings switch that toggles the evaluation gauge.

string.name: showResult
string.comment: This is the label of a button in the bottom bar shown when viewing a game from your history. Pressing the button will open a dialog showing the game's result (e.g 'White resigned') and displaying button such as 'new opponent'

string.name: signInWithBrowser
string.comment: Sign in option that starts the OAuth browser flow.

string.name: signInWithEmail
string.comment: Sign in option and screen title for the email login code flow.

string.name: simpleDelay
string.comment: Name of the simple delay chess clock time control type.

string.name: smallBoard
string.comment: Analysis/broadcast/study settings switch that uses a smaller board.

string.name: somethingWentWrong
string.comment: This is a generic text to be shown when something unexpected happens, e.g. failing to load data from the server.

string.name: sortBy
string.comment: Sheet title above the list of sort options.

string.name: sortFriends
string.comment: Accessibility label of the sort button on the friends screen.

string.name: sortOpenings
string.comment: Accessibility label of the button that sorts the list of puzzle openings.

string.name: sortStudies
string.comment: Accessibility label of the button that sorts the list of studies.

string.name: stopLiking
string.comment: Menu action that removes the user's like from a study.

string.name: stopShowingThreat
string.comment: This disables the 'Show Treat' mode in analysis.

string.name: systemColors
string.comment: The title of the system colors setting. When enabling this, tha app's colors will match those of the operating system.

string.name: tablebaseOffline
string.comment: Message shown when the endgame tablebase is not available offline.

string.name: tapToFetchPuzzles
string.comment: Shown in the offline puzzle cache when the user can fetch puzzles.

string.name: tapToRefresh
string.comment: Hint shown in the log screens, inviting the user to pull or tap to refresh.

string.name: teamStandings
string.comment: Title of the tournament tab listing team standings.

string.name: theme
string.comment: Graphic theme section in the global app settings.

string.name: tieBreaking
string.comment: Title above the list of tie-break scores in a broadcast.

string.name: toggleSound
string.comment: Accessibility label of the button that mutes and unmutes the app.

string.name: tooManyLoginAttempts
string.comment: Error shown when too many email login code requests were made.

resources.string: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

string.name: tournamentCompleted
string.comment: Title of a tab in the tournament screen, showing tournaments that are already completed. Translation should be short ideally one word

string.name: tournamentJumpToMyPage
string.comment: Accessibility description of a button that jumps to user's position in tournament standings

string.name: unsupportedVariant
string.comment: Shown when trying to access/play a variant not yet supported in the app.

resources.string: Variant %s is not supported in this version.

string.name: unusableNnueFilesExplanation
string.comment: Explanation shown in the engine settings before deleting unusable NNUE files.

resources.string: Some NNUE files on this device cannot be used by the engine. Deleting them frees up space and lets you download them again.

string.name: updatesFromTeams
string.comment: Empty state of the team updates screen.

resources.string: Updates from teams you join will appear here.

string.name: useSymmetricPieces
string.comment: Over the board display setting: use the same piece shape for both sides.

string.name: viewGame
string.comment: Button text in puzzle settings to view the originating game.

string.name: viewLicenses
string.comment: Account menu entry that opens the open source licenses page.

string.name: waitingForOpponentToJoin
string.comment: This is after the user has created a game and is waiting for an opponent to join.

string.name: watchTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues.

string.name: watchGames
string.comment: The watch tab entry that opens the list of live games, and the title of that list. Chess opens lichess TV and xiangqi opens the live games on xiangqi.com, which is why the entry names neither.

string.name: watchGamesSubtitle
string.comment: The line under the live games entry on the watch tab, saying which two places the games come from.

resources.string: Watch a game in progress on lichess or xiangqi.com.

string.name: weWillEmailYouCode
string.comment: Shown on the email sign in screen before requesting a login code.

resources.string: We will email you a code to sign in with.

string.name: winOrFiftyMoveDraw
string.comment: Tablebase verdict: the position is won, or drawn by the fifty move rule.

string.name: xiangqi
string.comment: Xiangqi, the Chinese chess variant, as opposed to international chess. Used as a game name in the offline opponent picker and as a screen title.

string.name: xiangqiBoardCoordinates
string.comment: The board coordinates setting, as it appears on the xiangqi game settings sheet. Nine files by ten ranks, unlike the chess board's eight by eight.

string.name: xiangqiCheckmated
string.comment: Xiangqi game-end sentence: the side named by %s is checkmated.

string.name: xiangqiDifficultyExplanation
string.comment: Xiangqi game settings sheet: the line under the difficulty setting, saying what a level actually controls.

resources.string: How long the computer is allowed to think.

string.name: xiangqiEasy
string.comment: Xiangqi engine strength: the easiest level.

string.name: xiangqiGuest
string.comment: The xiangqi.com account shown on the account screen while the session is the anonymous one the app made for a visitor. Not a signed-in xiangqi.com account, and not the lichess name either.

string.name: xiangqiHard
string.comment: Xiangqi engine strength: the hardest level.

string.name: xiangqiInvalidCredentials
string.comment: Error shown when a xiangqi.com email and password match no account.

string.name: xiangqiMedium
string.comment: Xiangqi engine strength: the medium level.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzle
string.comment: The title of the screen a xiangqi.com puzzle is solved on, and the name of the feature.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleFindBestMoveFor
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: the line that says whose move is being asked for. %s is a side, red or black.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleHintsExhausted
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: shown when the server refuses a hint because the day's hint allowance is spent.

resources.string: You have used all of today's hints.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleNoPuzzle
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: shown when the server has no puzzle to offer for the settings asked for.

resources.string: There is no puzzle available for these settings.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleQuotaLeft
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: how much of the day's puzzle allowance is left. %1$s is how many are left and %2$s is the day's total.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleSolutionWithheld
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: shown when the server answers with the position but withholds the answer, which is what it does once the day's puzzle allowance is spent.

resources.string: You have used all of today's puzzles. The position is here; the answer is not.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleSubtitle
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle menu: the line under the xiangqi puzzle tile, saying where its puzzles come from.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzleWrongMove
string.comment: Xiangqi puzzle screen: shown when the move played is not the puzzle's next one. The move is not played and the solver tries again.

string.name: xiangqiRanOutOfTime
string.comment: Xiangqi game-end sentence: the side named by %s used up its clock and lost. Chess says the same thing with its own white/black pair, which a xiangqi game cannot use.

string.name: xiangqiRedMovesFirst
string.comment: Xiangqi new game sheet: the line under the side setting once black is chosen, saying the computer opens the game.

resources.string: Red moves first, so the computer opens the game.

string.name: xiangqiResigned
string.comment: Xiangqi game-end sentence: the side named by %s resigned.

string.name: xiangqiReview
string.comment: The name of the game review feature, as the button that opens one and as the screen title.

string.name: xiangqiReviewAccuracy
string.comment: The game review's own word for how well a side played, from 0 to 100. xiangqi.com's Chinese uses 表现.

string.name: xiangqiReviewBrilliant
string.comment: Move classification, best of seven: a move that is both the engine's first choice and hard to find.

string.name: xiangqiReviewBest
string.comment: Move classification, second of seven: the engine's first choice.

string.name: xiangqiReviewExcellent
string.comment: Move classification, third of seven.

string.name: xiangqiReviewGood
string.comment: Move classification, fourth of seven.

string.name: xiangqiReviewInaccuracy
string.comment: Move classification, fifth of seven.

string.name: xiangqiReviewMistake
string.comment: Move classification, sixth of seven.

string.name: xiangqiReviewBlunder
string.comment: Move classification, worst of seven.

string.name: xiangqiReviewBestMoveWas
string.comment: Game review: the move the engine would have played instead. %s is a move in the game notation.

string.name: xiangqiReviewNoAnalysis
string.comment: Game review: shown when the server answered the review request with nothing to draw.

resources.string: The server did not analyse this game.

string.name: xiangqiReviewFailed
string.comment: Game review: shown when the review could not be loaded at all.

resources.string: The review could not be loaded.

string.name: xiangqiReviewOffline
string.comment: Game review: shown when the device is offline, since the analysis is the server's.

resources.string: You are offline. The review is the server's, so it needs a connection.

string.name: xiangqiReviewPrevious
string.comment: Game review: the bar button that steps back one move.

string.name: xiangqiReviewNext
string.comment: Game review: the bar button that steps forward one move.

string.name: xiangqiLeaderboardEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi leaderboard: shown when the server has no one on the board asked for. The three game boards really do answer with nobody on them.

string.name: xiangqiLeaderboardPlayers
string.comment: Xiangqi leaderboard: how many accounts the board holds. %s is the number.

string.name: xiangqiLeaderboardCountry
string.comment: Xiangqi leaderboard: the button that filters the board by country.

string.name: xiangqiLeaderboardAllCountries
string.comment: Xiangqi leaderboard: the choice that clears the country filter.

string.name: xiangqiHighestRating
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: the best rating the account has ever had for one speed.

string.name: xiangqiCountry
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: the label before the account's country.

string.name: xiangqiGamesPlayed
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: how many games the account has finished for one speed. Reused from chess, where it means the same thing.

string.name: xiangqiNoGames
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: shown when the account has no finished games to list.

string.name: xiangqiSpeedRapid
string.comment: Xiangqi: the rapid rating, on the profile and as a leaderboard tab. xiangqi.com files it as rapid_rating.

string.name: xiangqiSpeedBullet
string.comment: Xiangqi: the bullet rating, on the profile and as a leaderboard tab. xiangqi.com files it as bullet_rating.

string.name: xiangqiSpeedDaily
string.comment: Xiangqi: the daily (correspondence) rating, on the profile and as a leaderboard tab. xiangqi.com files it as daily_rating.

string.name: xiangqiSpeedPuzzle
string.comment: Xiangqi: the puzzle rating, on the profile and as a leaderboard tab. xiangqi.com files it as puzzle_rating.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzlesAttempted
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: how many puzzles the account has tried. %s is the number.

string.name: xiangqiPuzzlesSuccessRate
string.comment: Xiangqi profile: the share of puzzles the account solved. %s is a percentage.

string.name: xiangqiNotificationsEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi notifications screen: shown when the account has no notifications at all.

string.name: xiangqiNotificationsMarkAllRead
string.comment: Xiangqi notifications screen: the action that marks every notification read.

string.name: xiangqiFriendsEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi friends screen: shown when the account has no friends.

string.name: xiangqiFriendRequests
string.comment: Xiangqi friends screen: the tab, and the heading, for the friend requests waiting to be answered.

string.name: xiangqiFriendRequestsEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi friends screen: shown when there are no requests waiting.

string.name: xiangqiUnfriend
string.comment: Xiangqi friends screen: the action that removes somebody from the friends.

string.name: xiangqiSendFriendRequest
string.comment: Xiangqi friends screen: the action that asks somebody to be a friend.

string.name: xiangqiLessons
string.comment: Xiangqi lessons screen: the title of the course list, and the name of the feature.

string.name: xiangqiLessonsProgress
string.comment: Xiangqi lessons screen: how far through a topic or a lesson the account is. %1$s is how many are done and %2$s is how many there are.

string.name: xiangqiLessonChapters
string.comment: Xiangqi lesson screen: the heading of the list of chapters a lesson is made of.

string.name: xiangqiLessonNotPlayable
string.comment: Xiangqi lesson screen: shown in place of a chapter this app cannot draw a board for, saying why.

resources.string: This chapter is not playable in this app yet.

string.name: xiangqiLessonNoChapters
string.comment: Xiangqi lesson screen: shown when a lesson has no chapters to list.

string.name: xiangqiLessonScript
string.comment: Xiangqi chapter screen: the heading of the list of moves the chapter wants played.

string.name: xiangqiLessonScriptEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi chapter screen: shown when a chapter carries no moves, which is a chapter that only reads.

resources.string: This chapter has no moves to play.

string.name: xiangqiDatabase
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: the title of the master-games database, and the name of the feature.

string.name: xiangqiDatabasePlayers
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: the heading of the list of players the database is built around.

string.name: xiangqiDatabasePlayersEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: shown when a search finds no player.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseGames
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: the heading of a player's games.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseGamesEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: shown when a player has no games in the database.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseGamesCount
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: how many games of a player the database holds. %s is the number.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseWon
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: a game the player whose page this is won.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseLost
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: a game the player whose page this is lost.

string.name: xiangqiDatabaseDrawn
string.comment: Xiangqi database screen: a game the player whose page this is drew.

string.name: xiangqiSaved
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the title of the account's own content library, and the name of the feature.

string.name: xiangqiSavedPuzzles
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the tab, and the heading, for the puzzles this account has created.

string.name: xiangqiSavedNotes
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the tab, and the heading, for the game notes this account has saved.

string.name: xiangqiSavedNewFolder
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the action that makes a folder.

string.name: xiangqiSavedFolderName
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the field a folder's name is typed into.

string.name: xiangqiSavedRename
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the action that renames a folder.

string.name: xiangqiSavedDelete
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: the action that deletes a folder.

string.name: xiangqiSavedEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi saved-content screen: shown when a kind of content has nothing in it at all.

string.name: xiangqiTournaments
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: the title of the list, and the name of the feature.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsActive
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: the heading of the tournaments that are on or about to start.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsPrevious
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: the heading of the tournaments that are over.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: shown when there is no tournament in the section.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsStartsAt
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: when a tournament starts. %s is a date and a time.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsRounds
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: how many rounds a tournament has. %s is the number.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsParticipants
string.comment: Xiangqi tournaments screen: how many accounts have signed up. %s is the number.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsStandings
string.comment: Xiangqi tournament screen: the heading of the standings.

string.name: xiangqiTournamentsStandingsEmpty
string.comment: Xiangqi tournament screen: shown when the standings have nobody on them yet.

string.name: xiangqiSideBlack
string.comment: The black side of a xiangqi game, used as a side name in the game-end sentences.

string.name: xiangqiSideRed
string.comment: The red side of a xiangqi game, used as a side name in the game-end sentences.

string.name: xiangqiSignIn
string.comment: The entry that starts the xiangqi.com sign-in, and the title of the screen it opens. Named after the service, so that it does not read as a third way of signing in to lichess.

string.name: xiangqiStalemateLoss
string.comment: Xiangqi game-end sentence: the side named by %s has no legal move. Unlike chess, where having no move is a draw, in xiangqi it loses the game (困毙).

resources.string: %s has no legal move, which loses the game.

string.name: xiangqiThreefoldRepetition
string.comment: Xiangqi game-end sentence: the same position occurred three times, drawing the game.

resources.string: The same position came back three times, so the game is drawn.

string.name: xiangqiWatchNoGames
string.comment: Xiangqi watch screen: shown when xiangqi.com is listing no games in progress at all.

plurals.name: xiangqiWatchMoves
plurals.comment: Xiangqi watch screen: how far along a game is, in the pairs of moves a player counts rather than the plies the server does. %s is the number of moves.

string.name: youCannotChallengeYourself
string.comment: Error snackbar when trying to challenge yourself from the board editor.
